exposure: intra-cervical Foley catheter combined with vaginal isosorbide mononitrate
cohort: 395 pregnant women at term or post-term with an indication for labor induction and unripe cervix at Cairo University Hospital, Cairo, Egypt during 2012-2014
finding: Vaginal misoprostol resulted in a significantly lower duration of labor induction and lower cesarean section rates compared to Foley catheter combined with vaginal isosorbide mononitrate.
